extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic, brand-free elegant 1960s convertible: sky blue, long and flat with a chrome belt line, leather seats and rear bench, folded cream soft top, chrome-framed windshield, round headlights, wide low grille, vertical tail lights, slim chrome bumpers; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); open cockpit with dashboard and steering wheel; blank number plates, no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
